items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did he play much with the brass bands, Baby? [INTERVIEWEE] No. His Baby played much of it.

ctx.x: Did he play much with the brass bands, Baby?
No. His Baby played much of it.
Do you remember what orchestras he played with?

items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: He was a good E-flat man. ... He played with them all.

ctx.x: He was a good E-flat man. To whom? Good E-flat clarinet player? Yeah. He was a good E-flat man. Who did he play with on E-flat? He played with them all. He played with the...
Onward. And he played with the Tuxi, the band's drum.

items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Allen would find me more than anybody since I've been in the middle game. Allen would find me on the job.

ctx.x: Punch we had Allen. We had Allen. We had Tucker. They tell me Tucker's feeling better now. Yeah, that's good. They don't drink anymore.
How old was Allen at that time? Red Allen. Mm-hmm. How old was Red Allen then? I don't know.
